name: Austrian Empire (1804–1867)
description: A horizontal bicolour of black over yellow.
history: The black-and-gold colours of the Habsburgs, taken from the imperial eagle on gold, became the flag of the Austrian Empire proclaimed by Francis II on 11 August 1804 and were approved for civil use after the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire in 1806. The empire became Austria-Hungary in 1867 and the bicolour remained the flag of its Austrian half until 1918.

features.symbolism: the black and gold of the Habsburg arms, inherited from the imperial eagle of the Holy Roman Empire
